messages:
Maria K.: CI alert from yesterday: audit-telemetry job failing after the RBAC change in PR #4082. Golden fixture comparator shows a bunch of missing 'actor' fields in customer-facing events. Link: https://ci.redwood/4082/job/987
Josh L.: ugh, saw that. Is this the anonymization toggle we merged last week?
Samira N.: I think the toggle only affects internal logs, but RBAC mapping change might stop populating actor.display_name in some service accounts. KMS rotation happened around the same time too.
Cale R.: Pasted the failing assertion from the validator: ```assert event['actor']['id'] is not None``` The golden fixture has: "actor": null for ~1200 samples.
devops-bot: Re-run scheduled: https://ci.redwood/4082/rerun/123 (started) :gear:
auditor-bot: Quick diff summary: removed actor fields are all service-to-service calls where actor metadata was previously derived from keystore lookup. Most diffs are "actor": {"id":..., "role":...} => "actor": null.
Samira N.: That matches KMS proxy timing — keystore lookup had a short outage during key refresh and our fallback masked actor instead of using service identity.
Josh L.: Two quick options: 1) relax validator to accept null actor for these event types while we fix keystore; 2) update golden fixtures to include null where appropriate. I prefer (1) + a stricter postfix CI job that flags customer-visible schema regressions.
Cale R.: We should be careful: customer-facing audit events are contract. Relaxing validator could mask a real regression. Propose: change validator rule to allow actor null ONLY for event.kind == "internal_service_call" and add a new assertion that adds `meta.fallback_identity` when actor is null. Patch: ```if event['actor'] is None and event['kind']=='internal_service_call': event.setdefault('meta', {})['fallback_identity'] = event.get('source_service')```
Maria K.: Agree with Cale. Also we need a targeted test that replays the keystore outage and ensures we map fallback_identity consistently.
auditor-bot: Adding regression label to job: `audit-validator:allow-null-actor-temp` and creating golden snapshot diff artifact at s3://redwood-ci/audit-goldens/4082/diff-123.tar.gz
devops-bot: Canary deploy of validator patch queued to staging at 04:10 UTC.
Samira N.: Root cause remediation plan: - short-term: validator rule change + replay test (owner: Samira, ETA: 6h) - mid-term: keystore client retry/backoff + explicit service identity header (owner: Cale, ETA: 3d) - long-term: CI smoke that injects KMS rotation during golden generation (owner: Maria, ETA: 2w)
Josh L.: I'll shepherd the PR for the validator tweak. Will include the specific event kinds list and comment with the keystore outage link.
Cale R.: Also adding a lint in the audit fixture generator to prevent `actor: null` in customer-visible fixtures unless explicitly opted-in.
Maria K.: Excellent. Once canary passes, we run the golden comparator with `--strict-customer` and if green we merge.
Josh L.: Sounds good. I'll update the PR and ping here when CI is green. :thumbsup:
Maria K.: Thanks team — added to oncall checklist for this week in case similar flaps happen.
